tools.name: codeitso_get_materials
tools.description: Full details for 1-5 materials by id: official URL, license, source description, install command and snippet from the source, required auth, popularity, related materials, plus how to connect an MCP server (remote URLs, packages), API facts (base URL, env var names, OpenAPI spec, free tier) and font

tools.name: codeitso_browse
tools.description: Browse the catalog tree: no arguments lists the 6 categories and subcategories with counts; category lists its subcategories; subcategory lists its materials by popularity (default), name or recent update.

tools.name: codeitso_get_kits
tools.description: List codeitso starter kits (curated material sets for app types such as school info apps, games, office tools) or, with kit_id, one kit's materials and suggested build outline.

tools.name: codeitso_open_cart
tools.description: Read a codeitso cart share link a person made on the website (https://codeitso.yoorrard.workers.dev/cart#s=…): its materials with chosen AI model, official URL, install command, MCP remote URL and required auth. Only the part after # is read.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "codeitso_get_materials" references sensitive artifacts (env var). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Full details for 1-5 materials by id: official URL, license, source description, install command and snippet from the source, required auth, popularity, related…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: codeitso_get_materials, codeitso_open_cart · Private data: codeitso_get_materials, codeitso_find_models · Public sink: codeitso_open_cart.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: codeitso_get_materials, codeitso_open_cart · Private data: codeitso_get_materials, codeitso_find_models · Public sink: codeitso_open_cart

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
